# Neural Horizons AI

> Neural Horizons AI is a specialist agentic AI consultancy in the UAE, founded by Lisa Warren. It builds Zonar OS, a verification layer that reconciles orders, invoices and deliveries and proves every mismatch with the source row, and HALU, an intelligence agent that briefs department heads from verified findings. People approve every action that matters.

## Products
- [Platform overview](https://www.neuralhorizonsai.com/platform/): Zonar OS and HALU together, how they work, how they are built (deterministic engine, LLM and RAG explanation layer, human in the loop).
- [Zonar OS](https://www.neuralhorizonsai.com/zonar-os/): verification layer and Reconciliation Audit, the first live module.
- [HALU](https://www.neuralhorizonsai.com/halu/): cross-department intelligence agent, Lite, Pro and Enterprise tiers.
- [AI revenue leakage detection](https://www.neuralhorizonsai.com/revenue-leakage-detection/): what revenue leakage is, the three-way match, and how to detect it.
- [AI for Retail and FMCG](https://www.neuralhorizonsai.com/retail-fmcg-ai/): where retail and FMCG departments disagree (buying, warehouse, sales, finance) and how Zonar OS and HALU prove it.
- [AI for Digital and IT](https://www.neuralhorizonsai.com/digital-it-ai/): where IT, procurement and finance disagree (licences, usage, contracts, vendor invoices) and governed agentic AI.
- [AI Weak-Link Diagnostic](https://www.neuralhorizonsai.com/services/weak-link-diagnostic/): fixed-fee 2-week diagnosis of where a business loses money between departments.
- [Revenue Leak Calculator](https://www.neuralhorizonsai.com/revenue-leak-calculator/): free estimate.
